mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingPayment, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingDelivery, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReceive, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, COUNT(*) AS total FROM biz_order WHERE user_id = #{userId}
